# Welcome to [Physics Voyage]{.smallcaps}

I'm a [physicist]{.underline} in training, documenting the voyage through quantum mechanics, many-body theory, and the code that makes the cosmos computable.

This site is my open notebook — structured courses, project write-ups, and a blog that goes deeper than the textbook. No hand-waving. Everything built from first principles, mistakes included.

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() {
  async function fetchYouTubeData() {
    try {
      // Fetch the statically generated JSON file using relative path to support subpath hosting
      const response = await fetch("assets/scripts/youtube-data.json");
      if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error("Could not load assets/scripts/youtube-data.json");
      }
      const data = await response.json();
      
      // Latest Video
      document.getElementById("youtube-latest-iframe").src = `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${data.latest.id}`;
      const latestLink = document.getElementById("youtube-latest-title");
      latestLink.href = `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${data.latest.id}`;
      latestLink.textContent = data.latest.title;

      // Popular Video
      document.getElementById("youtube-popular-iframe").src = `https://www.youtube.com/embed/${data.popular.id}`;
      const popularLink = document.getElementById("youtube-popular-title");
      popularLink.href = `https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=${data.popular.id}`;
      popularLink.textContent = data.popular.title;
      
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error fetching YouTube data:", error);
      document.getElementById("youtube-latest-title").textContent = "Video unavailable";
      document.getElementById("youtube-popular-title").textContent = "Video unavailable";
    }
  }

  fetchYouTubeData();
});
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  // Wait for Quarto listing to be populated
  function buildCarousel() {
    const listingEl = document.querySelector('#listing-latest-posts-carousel');
    if (!listingEl) return;

    // Grab all rendered post cards from the hidden listing
    const cards = listingEl.querySelectorAll('.quarto-post');
    const inner = document.getElementById('posts-carousel-inner');
    if (!inner || cards.length === 0) return;

    inner.innerHTML = ''; // clear placeholder

    cards.forEach((card, i) => {
      // Extract data from the Quarto listing card
      const titleEl   = card.querySelector('.listing-title a') || card.querySelector('a');
      const dateEl    = card.querySelector('.listing-date');
      const descEl    = card.querySelector('.listing-description');
      const catEls    = card.querySelectorAll('.listing-category');

      const title    = titleEl   ? titleEl.textContent.trim()    : '';
      const href     = titleEl   ? titleEl.getAttribute('href')  : '#';
      const date     = dateEl    ? dateEl.textContent.trim()     : '';
      const desc     = descEl    ? descEl.textContent.trim()     : '';

      let badges = '';
      catEls.forEach((cat, j) => {
        const cls = j === 0 ? 'bg-dark' : 'bg-secondary';
        badges += `<span class="badge ${cls} me-1">${cat.textContent.trim()}</span>`;
      });

      const item = document.createElement('div');
      item.className = 'carousel-item' + (i === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      item.innerHTML = `
        <div class="card mb-3 blog-card-clickable" data-href="${href}" role="button" tabindex="0"
             style="cursor:pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.2s, transform 0.2s;"
             onclick="window.location.href='${href}'">
          <div class="card-body">
            <h6 class="card-title mb-1" style="white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;">
              <span class="text-decoration-none text-reset fw-semibold">${title}</span>
            </h6>
            ${date ? `<small class="text-muted">${date}</small><br>` : ''}
            <div class="mt-1" style="white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; padding-bottom: 2px;">${badges}</div>
            ${desc ? `<div class="mt-2 text-muted" style="font-size:0.9em; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden;">${desc}</div>` : ''}
            <div class="mt-2" style="font-size:0.82em; color:#6c757d;">Click to read &rarr;</div>
          </div>
        </div>`;

      // Keyboard accessibility: Enter key also navigates
      item.querySelector('.blog-card-clickable').addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
        if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
          window.location.href = href;
        }
      });

      inner.appendChild(item);
    });
  }

  // Quarto fires this event when listings are loaded
  if (window['quarto-listing-loaded']) {
    window.addEventListener('quarto-listing-loaded', buildCarousel);
  }
  // Fallback: try after a short delay
  setTimeout(buildCarousel, 600);
});
</script>
